subject: general
question: Which UN organisation is concerned with illicit trafficking and drug abuse?
solution:
The correct answer is __**UNODC**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **UNODC** stands for the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime.
 
• It is responsible for addressing issues related to illicit trafficking, drug abuse, and organized crime.
 
• UNODC works globally to combat these issues through research, policy-making, and practical assistance to member states.
 
• It also deals with terrorism prevention, criminal justice, and corruption, among other areas.
 
• UNODC's efforts are crucial in promoting health, security, and justice across the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNODC** was established in 1997 through a merger between the United Nations Drug Control Programme and the Centre for International Crime Prevention.
 
• Headquartered in Vienna, Austria, UNODC operates in all regions of the world through an extensive network of field offices.
 
• The organization provides legal and technical assistance to countries to strengthen their criminal justice systems and reduce vulnerabilities to organized crime and drug trafficking.
 
• UNODC also publishes the annual World Drug Report, which provides comprehensive data and analysis on the global drug situation.
 
• Through its various programs and initiatives, UNODC aims to achieve a safer and healthier world free from the threats posed by drugs and crime.
